facts.fact: The 2021-23 SIM registration required subscribers to link SIM cards to Ghana Cards; the exercise ended on 31 May 2023.
By October 2022, about 28.96 million SIM cards (67.28% of those issued) were linked to Ghana Cards and 18.93 million (44.28%) had completed both stages, per the article.

The Communications Minister said on 7 September 2026 that Parliament had passed the LI for SIM registration and a biometric verification phase would be introduced before end-2026 so SIMs are linked to verified identities.
